corporate_actions.subject: Face Value Split (Sub-Division) - From Rs 2/- Per Share To Re 1/- Per Share
Annual General Meeting/Dividend - Rs 2 Per Share

guidance.statement: Consolidated revenue growth of 12-13% in FY27, in INR terms
Consolidated EBITDA margin of about 22-22.3% in FY27
Unichem EBITDA margin to recover to 12-13% in FY27
Unichem US business to grow about 10% in FY27
Domestic branded business growth of about 12% in FY27, with 1-2% from new products
Overall business to grow 14-16% in FY27, raised from 12-13%
Consolidated EBITDA margin to remain around 23%, raised from 22%
Institutional generics business around ₹260-300 Cr with single-digit growth
Capex of ₹700-800 Cr in the current year
Long-term debt to fall to ₹70 Cr by year-end, repaid fully next financial year
Consolidated EBITDA margin of 25-26% in 2-3 years
Biosimilar revenue to start flowing from FY29-FY30

operating_notes.text: FY26 domestic formulations grew 10% to ₹3,817 Cr and Q4 grew 12% to ₹853 Cr; Ipca's MAT March 2026 market share was 2.09%.
Institutional business fell 24% in FY26 to ₹270 Cr and 33% in Q4 on funding constraints at the institution.
Material costs are seen up 10-12% and Q4 freight up about 25%; material cost to sales is about 25%.
Europe generics revenue rose from ₹33 Cr to ₹137 Cr in Q1FY27, the main driver of generic growth.
Domestic formulations grew 13% in Q1FY27 on about 5% volume, 4.5-5% price and about 2% new launches; antimalarial sales fell 24% and are now about 1% of business.
Container freight rose to ₹9,000-10,000 for South America and ₹12,500-13,000 for the US from ₹3,000 and ₹7,000-7,500 respectively.

timeline.summary: On its 1 June 2026 Q4FY26 call, Ipca guided FY27 consolidated revenue growth of 12-13% and EBITDA margin of about 22-22.3%, after FY26 margin of 20.72% beat its 20% guidance.
On 14 August 2026 IPCA's Q1FY27 call raised FY27 revenue growth guidance to 14-16% and consolidated EBITDA margin guidance to 23%.
